lines.en: How did the woman get help?
lines.zh: 这位妇女是怎样获得救援的？

lines.en: When a light passenger plane flew off course some time ago,
lines.zh: 前些日子，一架小型客机偏离航线

lines.en: it crashed in the mountains and its pilot was killed.
lines.zh: 在山区坠毁，飞行员当场丧生。

lines.en: The only passengers, a young woman and her two baby daughters, were unhurt.
lines.zh: 唯一的乘客，一位年轻的妇女和她的两个女婴却安然无恙。

lines.en: It was the middle of winter.
Snow lay thick on the ground.
lines.zh: 地上覆盖着厚厚的积雪。

lines.en: The woman knew that the nearest village was miles away.
lines.zh: 妇女知道最近的村庄也在数英里之外。

lines.en: When it grew dark, she turned a suitcase into a bed and put the children inside it,
lines.zh: 天黑时，她把一只手提箱当作小床，把孩子们放了进去，

lines.en: covering them with all the clothes she could find.
lines.zh: 又把自己能找到的所有衣服都盖在了她们身上。

lines.en: During the night, it got terribly cold.
lines.zh: 夜里，天气变得异常寒冷。

lines.en: The woman kept as near as she could to the children and even tried to get into the case herself, but it was too small.
lines.zh: 妇女尽可能地靠近孩子，甚至想自己也钻进箱子里，但箱子太小了。

lines.en: she heard planes passing overhead and wondered how she could send a signal.
lines.zh: 她听到飞机从头顶飞过，心想该如何发出求救信号呢？

lines.en: Then she had an idea. She stamped out the letters 'SOS' in the snow.
lines.zh: 接着她有了一个主意。她在雪地上踩出了“SOS”这几个字母。

lines.en: Fortunately, a pilot saw the signal and sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，一名飞行员看到了这个信号，并用无线电把消息发给了最近的城镇。

lines.en: It was not long before a helicopter arrived on the scene to rescue the survivors of the plane crash.
lines.zh: 不久，一架直升机飞抵现场，营救了这次飞机坠毁事故的幸存者。
